title: Research Attention Item
description: Immutable authored researcher choices, unavailable study facts or team tasks. Historical 1.0.0, contextual 1.1.0 and scoped 1.2.0 remain readable. The revised catalog validates compact researcher metadata for new outputs without inventing it for historical records.

question.description: One direct current choice, factual request or team task. Newly authored researcher inquiries follow the supplied user-inquiry reference: question at most 20 prose words, with complete primary choice/fact limits. Actual run/request state determines optional versus waiting-for-input; unanswered alone never establishes a pause.

likely_consequence.description: What the answer changes in target, intended claim, applicability or resources, without repeating option accounts. New context plus this field has at most 45 prose words under the supplied user-inquiry reference; preserve decisive conditions. Scientific importance does not establish a pause.

kind.description: The author distinguishes consequential unresolved researcher preferences or unavailable study facts from scientific justification, proof, implementation and evaluation work owned by the team.

target_phase.description: Phase where the researcher decision belongs or the team should carry out the work, not necessarily the originating phase. P1 setting clarifications and goal ambiguities belong in Decisions to Discuss.

context_markdown.description: The affected target, component or missing fact, with essential local symbols and scientific meaning. Follow the supplied user-inquiry reference; newly authored context plus likely_consequence has at most 45 prose words. Preserve essential definitions and decisive conditions before source history, repeated context or UI-supplied optionality labels; link additional mechanism detail. Authors name what can proceed or which authorized action needs input; the UI derives optional or waiting state from run/request state.

why_it_matters.description: Optional historical supporting rationale. New briefs need no separate repetition of the affected point and practical consequence.

expected_consequence.description: Optional historical supporting rationale. New briefs need no separate repetition of the affected point and practical consequence.

checkability.description: Optional historical supporting rationale. New briefs need no separate repetition of the affected point and practical consequence.

information_limits.description: Optional historical supporting rationale. New briefs need no separate repetition of the affected point and practical consequence.

decision_priority.description: Highest material consequence, authored by the Lead. These are ordered priorities, not a questionnaire or urgency levels. Required for new researcher_decision items under consequential_researcher_decisions_v1; absent historical values stay absent.

response_kind.description: A choice asks for a consequential unresolved preference; study_fact requests unavailable information. Researcher reports remain unverified until supported. Required for new researcher_decision items under consequential_researcher_decisions_v1.

options.description: Alternatives for a genuine choice, usually two or three unique {id,label,consequence} objects when useful. Follow the supplied user-inquiry reference: each new label plus consequence has at most 30 prose words; the complete primary choice inquiry has at most 180. Put a justified suggested option first and bind recommended_option_id to its exact stable id, without preselection. Preserve historical order/IDs and legacy alternatives. Omit for study_fact.

consequence.description: This option's changed formulation when mathematical, followed by its scientific meaning and material practical benefit/cost. Define shared notation once in context_markdown. New label plus consequence has at most 30 prose words under the user-inquiry reference; compact formulas are additional but their prose explanations count. No artificial equation is needed for a nonmathematical choice.

recommendation.description: Every choice supplies a short Lead reason for a justified suggestion, or why no ranking is justified, within 20 prose words for new inquiries. Follow the supplied user-inquiry reference. Omit for study_fact; never treat advice as preselection or a researcher answer. The optional recommended_option_id binds a justified suggestion to an exact authored option.

recommended_option_id.description: Optional exact id of a justified suggested choice option, authored first in new option arrays and accompanied by recommendation. It must name an existing authored option; omit when no recommendation is justified and for study_fact. No historical badge, ranking or answer is inferred from prose or position.
